notes.title: 🌙 Awaking Beauty Demo v0.1.1 Update Is Live｜Thank You for Dreaming with Us
notes.notes: [p]To all dreamwalkers exploring the Dream Realm—thank you for jumping into the Awaking Beauty demo right away. We’ve received a lot of feedback and kind words from players around the world, and we truly appreciate every one of them.[/p][p][/p][p]Version 0.1.1 focuses on fixing issues found in the initial release, along with some adjustments to combat balance and AI behavior based on your feedback. We hope this makes your dream journey smoother and more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]＊ Analog stick input now functions properly[/p][p]＊ Layout of the initial settings screen has been adjusted[/p][p]＊ Fixed the low damage issue with the shotgun[/p][p]＊ Dialogue screens now scale properly on all screen ratios[/p][p]＊ Weapon info now displays correctly when discarding weapons[/p][p]＊ Fixed players taking damage at spawn when restarting[/p][p]＊ Fixed occasional issues with skill activation[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ New Features[/b][/p][p]＊ Added Nintendo Switch button icon support[/p][p]＊ No more accidental teleportation after chase finishers[/p][p]＊ Lunar stage gravity now behaves as intended[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][p]＊ Enemy HP ratio globally reduced[/p][p]＊ Number of enemies appearing simultaneously is now limited[/p][p]＊ Healing items added to boss arenas[/p][p]＊ Melee heavy attacks now bypass super armor on regular enemies[/p][p]＊ Landing recovery time halved; momentum is preserved[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ AI Improvements[/b][/p][p]＊ AI allies dodge more effectively[/p][p]＊ AI is now more aggressive in combat[/p][p]＊ Fixed AI avoiding Popcorn Classmate (yes, him...)[/p][p]＊ AI-controlled characters now receive slight damage reduction[/p][p]＊ AI will now prioritize reviving teammates immediately[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ Visual & Presentation Enhancements[/b][/p][p]＊ Overall visual quality improved across all stages[/p][p]＊ Transformation animation can now be fast-forwarded[/p][p]＊ Fallen enemy corpses now behave properly and stay in the background[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ Extras[/b][/p][p]＊ Squashed a few mischievous bugs (Bug team strikes again!)[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue to refine the experience of Awaking Beauty, and your feedback is always welcome.[/p][p]This dream is still unfolding—thank you for choosing to walk it with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishing you sweet dreams,[/p][p]See you on the other side.[/p][p]Yohcan Studio[/p]
